title: Recovering deleted files
text:
Files you delete are moved to the Trash, where they stay for 30 days on the Free and Plus plans and for 180 days on the Business plan.

To bring a file back, open Trash in the web app, select the file and choose Restore. The file returns to its original folder. If that folder no longer exists, Nimbus recreates it.

After the retention period the file is purged permanently and support cannot recover it.

title: Version history
text:
Every time a file changes, Nimbus keeps the previous revision. You can open the Versions panel from the file menu to compare revisions and roll back to an earlier one.

Plus keeps 100 revisions per file for 90 days. Business keeps unlimited revisions for one year. Rolling back creates a new revision, so no history is lost.

title: Plans and storage limits
text:
Nimbus offers three plans. Free includes 5 GB of storage. Plus includes 2 TB and costs 9.99 euros per month. Business includes 5 TB per user, with a minimum of three users, and costs 15 euros per user per month.

Annual billing gives two months free on Plus and Business.

title: What happens when your storage is full
text:
When you reach your quota, existing files stay available but syncing stops: new or changed files are not uploaded until you free up space or upgrade.

Shared folders count against the owner's quota only. Files in the Trash still count until they are purged, so emptying the Trash is the quickest way to recover space.

title: Changing your plan
text:
You can upgrade at any time from Settings > Billing; the price difference is prorated for the current billing period.

Downgrading takes effect at the end of the billing period. If your files exceed the new quota, your account becomes read-only until you are back under the limit.

title: Cancelling your subscription and refunds
text:
Cancel from Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription. Your paid features remain active until the end of the period you have paid for, then the account reverts to Free.

Annual subscriptions cancelled within 14 days of purchase are refunded in full. Monthly subscriptions are not refunded.

title: Two-step verification
text:
Two-step verification protects your account with a second factor in addition to your password. Nimbus supports authenticator apps (TOTP) and hardware security keys (FIDO2/WebAuthn). SMS codes are not offered because they are vulnerable to SIM swapping.

When you turn it on, Nimbus shows ten single-use recovery codes. Store them somewhere safe: they are the only way back in if you lose your device.

title: Lost your phone or security key
text:
If you can no longer produce a verification code, sign in with one of your recovery codes and register a new device.

Without recovery codes, an identity check by support is required. It takes up to five business days and cannot be shortened, because it protects you against account takeover.

title: Resetting a forgotten password
text:
Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. Nimbus emails a reset link that expires after one hour.

If end-to-end encrypted vaults are enabled, resetting the password without your recovery key makes the vault contents unreadable, since Nimbus never holds the key.

title: How your data is encrypted
text:
All files are encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Encryption keys are managed by Nimbus in a hardware security module.

For sensitive documents you can create an encrypted Vault folder. Vault files are encrypted on your device before upload (end-to-end encryption), so Nimbus staff and infrastructure cannot read them. Vault files cannot be previewed in the browser or searched by content.

title: Where your data is stored
text:
Business customers choose the region where their files are stored: European Union (Frankfurt and Paris) or United States. The choice is made when the workspace is created and applies to files and backups.

Free and Plus accounts are stored in the EU region. Nimbus does not move data between regions without the customer's request.

title: Exporting or deleting your personal data
text:
You can download a copy of all your files and account data from Settings > Privacy > Export. The archive is prepared within 48 hours and the download link stays valid for seven days.

To erase your account permanently, use Delete account. Files are removed immediately from active storage and from backups within 30 days.

title: Sharing files with a link
text:
Select a file or folder and choose Share > Copy link. Anyone with the link can view the content by default. You can restrict the link to people in your organization, protect it with a password, or set an expiry date.

Password-protected and expiring links are available on Plus and Business.

title: Inviting people to a folder
text:
Invite collaborators by email to a shared folder and choose a role: Viewer can open and download, Commenter can also comment, Editor can add, change and delete files.

Only the owner can delete the shared folder itself or transfer ownership. Removing someone from a folder revokes access immediately on all their devices.

title: Controlling external sharing (Business)
text:
Administrators can limit sharing outside the organization from the admin console: allow it, allow it only with password-protected links, or block it entirely. A list of trusted domains can be exempted.

The policy applies to new links; existing public links can be revoked in bulk from the Sharing report.

title: Choosing which folders sync to a computer
text:
Selective sync lets you keep some folders only in the cloud to save disk space. Open the desktop app preferences, go to Sync and untick the folders you do not need locally.

Files On-Demand goes further: everything appears in your file explorer, but content downloads only when you open a file.

title: Understanding conflicted copies
text:
If the same file is edited on two devices before they sync, Nimbus keeps both versions. The second one is saved next to the original with the name of the device and the date, for example report (laptop's conflicted copy 2026-03-02).

Open both versions, merge the changes manually, then delete the copy you no longer need.

title: The desktop app is not syncing
text:
First check the status icon: a pause symbol means sync was paused, a red cross means an error. Common causes are a full quota, a file name with characters not allowed on the other operating system, a path longer than 260 characters on Windows, or a file larger than 50 GB.

If the app is stuck, quit it and start it again; it will rescan your folders without uploading everything again.

title: Limiting upload and download speed
text: On slow or metered connections you can cap bandwidth in the desktop app preferences under Network. By default uploads are limited automatically to leave room for other applications, and downloads are not limited.

title: Supported operating systems
text:
The desktop app runs on Windows 10 and 11, macOS 13 or later, and Ubuntu 22.04 or later. Mobile apps are available for iOS 16+ and Android 10+.

The web app works in the last two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge.

title: Backing up photos from your phone
text:
Turn on Camera uploads in the mobile app to back up new photos and videos automatically. You can choose to upload only on Wi-Fi and only while charging.

Photos are stored in the Camera Uploads folder and count against your storage quota.

title: Using files without an internet connection on mobile
text: Mark a file or folder as Available offline in the mobile app. Nimbus downloads it and keeps it updated whenever the phone is online. Offline files are stored encrypted in the app's private storage.

title: File size and type limits
text:
Through the desktop and mobile apps you can upload files up to 50 GB each. Uploads in the web browser are limited to 10 GB per file.

There is no restriction on file types, but executable files shared by public link are scanned for malware before others can download them.

title: Getting started with the admin console
text:
Business administrators manage users, groups, billing and security policies from the admin console. You can add users one by one, import a CSV file, or provision them automatically with SCIM from your identity provider.

Removed users' files are transferred to an administrator you choose, so nothing is lost when someone leaves.

title: Single sign-on with SAML or OpenID Connect
text:
Business workspaces can require single sign-on through any SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect identity provider, such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace or Keycloak.

Once SSO is enforced, passwords stored by Nimbus are disabled and two-step verification is handled by your identity provider.

title: Audit log
text:
The audit log records sign-ins, sharing changes, downloads, deletions and admin actions with user, IP address and time. Business administrators can search it in the admin console, export it as CSV, or stream it to a SIEM through the events API.

Entries are kept for 12 months.

title: Developer API
text:
The Nimbus REST API lets applications upload, download and search files. Requests are authenticated with OAuth 2.0; personal access tokens are available for scripts.

The default rate limit is 600 requests per minute per user. When it is exceeded the API answers with HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header indicating how many seconds to wait.

title: Webhooks
text:
Webhooks notify your application when files are created, modified, deleted or shared. Nimbus sends a signed POST request to your endpoint; verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Nimbus-Signature header before trusting the payload.

Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.

title: Searching your files
text:
Search looks at file names and, for documents, PDFs and images with text, at their content. Results appear as you type and can be filtered by type, owner and modification date.

New files are searchable within a few minutes. Files in an encrypted Vault are searchable by name only.

title: Contacting support
text:
Free users can get help from the community forum and the help center. Plus subscribers can open email tickets, answered within one business day. Business customers also have phone support from 8:00 to 20:00 CET on weekdays and a 4-hour response target for urgent issues.

The service status and incident history are published on status.nimbus.example.

title: Service level agreement
text:
Nimbus commits to 99.9 % monthly availability for Business workspaces. If availability falls below the commitment, administrators can claim service credits from 10 % to 30 % of the monthly fee, depending on the downtime.

Scheduled maintenance is announced at least 72 hours in advance and does not count as downtime.
